def min_swaps_to_sort_strings(strings):
    n = len(strings)
    target = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: strings[i])
    visited = [False] * n
    swaps = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if visited[i] or target[i] == i:
            continue
        length = 0
        j = i
        while not visited[j]:
            visited[j] = True
            j = target[j]
            length += 1
        swaps += length - 1
    return swaps
